summary: Iter 199 — Tested Smart POS Journal upgrade on /accounting/journal-entries. All 8 templates verified: بيع فوري, بيع نقدي, بيع بنكي/بطاقة, رواتب, صرف نقدي, تحصيل من عميل, سداد لمورد, إيداع بنكي. No separate cashier cart tab (correctly merged into items section). Customer/Vehicle/Items fields show/hide correctly per template config. Backend POST /api/finance/journal-entries working — created 4 test entries (instant_sale, salary, collect_customer, pay_supplier) all balanced. View mode toggle (POS/Full) working with localStorage persistence. All data-testid attributes present and functional.

integration_issues.issue: Console shows 'Failed to fetch' errors for journal-entries, chart-of-accounts, workshop-profile, workshop-settings on initial load. These appear to be transient network issues during Playwright automation (curl tests to same endpoints succeed). The page still renders correctly after retry.

critical_code_review_comments: SmartPOSJournal.jsx (1097 lines) is well-structured with clear template configuration (TEMPLATE_META array). Each template correctly defines: supportsItems, supportsVehicle, requiresParty, defaultPaymentMethod, paymentSide, counterAccountKey.

Template field visibility logic verified: salary hides party/vehicle, shows items; collect_customer shows party/vehicle, hides items; pay_supplier shows party, hides vehicle/items; bank_deposit hides payment methods (static paymentSide).
Account mapping (accountRefs) correctly picks accounts by code or Arabic name patterns. Bank deposit correctly maps debit=004 (bank), credit=003 (cash).
Items section merged into POS (no separate cashier cart tab) — confirmed by absence of [data-testid='cashier-cart-tab'] and presence of [data-testid='pos-items-section'] within SmartPOSJournal.
JournalEntries.jsx passes apiBase, workshopId, accounts, recentEntries to SmartPOSJournal. The onSaved callback was fixed in iteration 198 (fetchJournalEntries instead of fetchEntries).

success_rate.backend: 100% — POST /api/finance/journal-entries created 4 balanced entries (instant_sale 100 ر.س, salary 3500 ر.س, collect_customer 500 ر.س, pay_supplier 1200 ر.س). GET returns entries correctly.
success_rate.frontend: 100% — All 8 templates render with correct field visibility. View mode toggle works. Items section shows for templates with supportsItems:true. Party/Vehicle fields show/hide per template config. No separate cashier cart tab.

seed_data_creation: Created 4 journal entries via backend API during testing: (1) instant_sale 100 ر.س with party/vehicle tags, (2) salary 3500 ر.س, (3) collect_customer 500 ر.س, (4) pay_supplier 1200 ر.س. All balanced double-entry.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Smart POS Journal upgrade is complete and working. All 8 templates verified. The cashier cart is now merged into the items section within SmartPOSJournal. Key data-testids: pos-journal-root, pos-templates-grid, pos-template-{key}, pos-party-input, pos-vehicle-input, pos-items-section, pos-item-add-button, pos-save-button, pos-save-toast, journal-view-mode-toggle, journal-mode-pos-button, journal-mode-full-button.
